patterns.objective: Verify that reset deassertion leads to ready within the allowed window.
patterns.native_instruction: DRIVE RESET LOW 5ns; DRIVE RESET HIGH; EXPECT READY WITHIN 20 CYCLES
patterns.expected_result: ready == 1 within 20 cycles after reset release
patterns.human_review: Confirm reset deassertion timing with the design owner.

patterns.objective: Verify that four consecutive writes receive acknowledgements.
patterns.native_instruction: LOOP 4 WRITE ADDR++ DATA++; EXPECT ACK EACH WRITE
patterns.human_review: Confirm whether address wraparound is legal.

patterns.objective: Verify that the block remains stable when clock jitter is applied within environment limits.
patterns.native_instruction: SET CLOCK_JITTER MAX_ALLOWED; RUN 100 CYCLES; EXPECT READY STABLE
patterns.expected_result: ready remains stable during jitter run
patterns.human_review: Confirm jitter distribution and measurement method.
